metadata.coverage: actual Coverage; admission requires complete expected=observed=row_count

operands.p_c: exact integer close coefficient of the EQ166 last structurally positive-volume completed regular BAR (OPEN O1)
operands.p_s: exact integer supplied authoritative close coefficient; same scale; no rescaling

mathematics.bps: bps = 10000 * |p_c - p_s| / p_s as an exact rational; denominator is the supplied close only
mathematics.published_value: float64 = float(Fraction(10000*|p_c-p_s|, p_s)); single final correctly rounded (IEEE binary64 round-half-even) conversion; D=0 gives +0.0
mathematics.within_tolerance: exact integer test 10000*|p_c-p_s|*tolerance_bps_den <= tolerance_bps_num*p_s ; inclusive; never evaluated on the rounded float
mathematics.overflow: no int64/float64 overflow possible: numerator <=10000*(2^63-1) ~ 9.2e22, result <= 9.223372036854776e22; implementations need arbitrary or >=128-bit integers
mathematics.zero_negative_denominator: p_s=0: state reference_invalid; bps/within not_applicable/zero_denominator; supplied_price missing_input/ineligible. p_s<0: all three missing_input/ineligible
mathematics.uninspected_values: a price on a row whose known_at is null or >K, or whose batch coverage is incomplete, is not inspected and cannot influence any output

quality.reasons: single reported reason: when several apply, the first applicable in this order wins: absent_input, unknown_availability, future_knowledge, null_field, ineligible, governed_gap, no_eligible_observations, zero_denominator; status follows that reason
quality.admission_precedence: incomplete batch coverage takes precedence over price validity: the row is not admitted and its price is not inspected
quality.supplied_price_counts: expected=authoritative_close Coverage.expected (null when slot missing or unknown), observed=row count (0 when slot missing)
quality.bps_and_within_counts: expected=2, observed=number of independently ready operands (calculated close ready; supplied close admitted)
quality.witnesses: bars: EQ166 selected last positive-volume completed BAR witness (boundary completed_interval); authoritative_close: row_id=reference_id, event_ns=effective_start_ns, known_at original, effective bounds original, use consumed. bps/within/supplied_price cite witnesses only when their value is available; comparison_state cites every causal applicable witness

mode_rule: known_at and reconstruction availability modes give identical results; original known_at is required in both
fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. p_c and reasons stand for the independent EQ166 oracle result on valid calendar/bars/population packets (to be expanded). auth.rows list every supplied row. C/K/E: market_cutoff, knowledge_cutoff and evaluation ns; session open=10 close=30; entity X/S; namespace fixture; PriceUnit(scale, USD).

amendment_1.defect: C02 (market cutoff 20 < close 30) expected an available supplied_price with a witness at event_ns = close_ns; FeatureResult rejects consumed evidence past the market cutoff, so it was unproducible
amendment_1.provisional_rule: when market_cutoff_ns < session.close_ns the supplied close lies beyond the market bound and is not projected: supplied_price status incomplete_coverage, value null, reason governed_gap, no witness; the other three outputs are not comparable per O4; the authoritative_close witness is never cited (comparison_state included); bps/within observed count excludes the unprojectable supplied operand
clarifications: 1 a wholly missing price column reads as null_field
2 no_eligible_observations on a complete calculated side ranks immediately before zero_denominator; status not_applicable

3 coverage precedence concerns price inspection only: null_field, ineligible and zero_denominator are not applied when batch coverage is incomplete; unknown_availability and future_knowledge come from known_at, not price inspection, still apply and rank before governed_gap (R17, R18)
4 the provisional governed_gap is added by this producer on top of EQ166's available prefix close
